content.summary: A night courier moves from studio identity cards into a mono-wheel city ride. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: At least three adult identity anchors persist. + One body or prop action triggers each graphic module. + Typography is exact and readable. + The vehicle chapter retains the same wardrobe and face. + The final wide frame restores person, carrier, world and title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Introduce one original adult courier with a teal bob, white gloves and a red utility vest beside a cobalt mono-wheel under the exact title NIGHT SHIFT. One visor adjustment activates a thin amber route grid around her eyes. Pull to a rear wide view and hold rider, vehicle, cyan route grid and exact final line NIGHT SHIFT / ACTIVE.
